system.summary: Two- and three-digit numbers among clear German and Latin (e.g. 120.65.47.83.56.103.61.77 on R4333 image 1); the archive notes them as unsolved cipher. Not studied.
system.notes: Whether the five letters share one key is not established. DECODE gives R4334 and R4335 symbol set 'Alphabet', the others 'Numerical'. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from riksarkivet1628 (catalogue 207).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched the 14 DECODE records of catalogue 207 with the project cookie; R4333-R4337 are J. J. von Rusdorff's letters to Axel Oxenstierna from The Hague, 1628, with figures inside clear German and Latin. Surveyed only.

Split from the former catalogue-207 group entry riksarkivet1628 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026); the Rusdorff letters are another correspondence and cipher. Image 1 of R4333 viewed again (a cipher sentence of eight figure groups). Not transcribed, not attacked.

George Lasry's PR 72 recovered the key of R4336/R4337 (London 1625; homophonic 16-87 with an alphabetical 187-760 nomenclator); they move to rusdorff1625. R4333 image 3 is German with numbers 8-107, outside that table, so R4333-R4335 stay here as a different cipher. Kröger 1876 reports Rusdorf's copybook of his Oxenstierna letters 1624-1628 at Kassel (unprinted then), a probable clear-text source; not consulted.

outcome.method_basis: Surveyed only: the three letters were opened and their cipher noted, but nothing was transcribed or attacked.
outcome.fraction_read_source: No transcription; no group has a value.

gaps.detail: surveyed only; no transcription, no key search; the rusdorff1625 key does not fit R4333; Rusdorf's Kassel copybook (Kröger 1876) not consulted; Oxenstierna's printed correspondence not searched

outcome.notes: Split on 14 Oct 2026 from riksarkivet1628; R4336/R4337 moved to rusdorff1625 on 21 Oct 2026. In progress: not yet worked.
